accepted_corrections: Distinct canonical environment-variable and HTTP field-name grammars.
Canonical and alternative numeric IP authority rejection for URL and email.

decisive_finding.cause: The shared public DNS classifier rejects example.com and subdomains but admits RFC 2606 documentation domains example.net, example.org, and their subdomains through both HTTPS and email semantics.

corrective_scope: Reject exact and subdomain forms of example.com, example.net, and example.org through one shared public DNS classifier.
Retain numeric-IP, reserved-suffix, local authority, URL, email, MCP key/shape, prompt, metadata, and package-reachability behavior.
Add URL/email unit controls and paired N02/N04 consumer controls for exact and subdomain documentation domains.
Run focused, full distribution, inventory, and all-target checks with 16 jobs, then freeze exact NODE-011 for independent rereview.
claim_ceiling: N04 numeric-IP and MCP-key semantics are corrected, but complete canonical manifest semantics and all package/install/discovery/runtime claims remain unaccepted. N04 closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim N04 completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
